disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni, Fe and Cu in muscle, brain and liver of seven meat, poultry and game animals bought in Noakhali markets.

study.design: Market survey of meat, poultry, game and offal with health-risk assessment
study.market: Maijdee Bazar, Pouro Bazar and Sonapur Bazar local markets, Noakhali district, Bangladesh
study.method: AAS (PerkinElmer PinAAcle 900H, deuterium background correction) after HNO3/H2SO4 + H2O2 digestion of oven-dried tissue
study.lod_text: LODs referred to supplementary material (not available)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Maximum allowable concentrations used by authors (JECFA 2005/2012): Cd 0.1, Cr 1, Pb 0.1, Ni 0.5, Cu 0.1 mg/kg
Hazard index from foodstuff consumption (adults, children)

unresolved: Methods say 63 samples of seven animal types, but Table 1 lists n = 9 for each of 21 species-tissue groups (189); sample count is inconsistent.
Results labelled mg/kg fresh weight although samples were dried at 60 °C; the dry-to-fresh conversion is not described.
Copper concentrations of 77-474 mg/kg fresh weight and lead up to 81.87 mg/kg in goat liver are implausibly high for meat and offal; no CRM or recovery data are reported in the main text.
LOD values and instrument conditions are in supplementary material that was not available.
Table 1 MAC of 0.1 mg/kg for Cu is inconsistent with JECFA practice; recorded as printed.
